का.आ. 229(अ).-- केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें 
इसके पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 1155 तारीख 07/03/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग ॥, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा मध्य प्रदेश राज्य के बैतूल जिले में NH347A 
के कि.मी. 0+000 से 23+925 कि.मी. तक मुलताई - प्रभातपट्टन से मध्यप्रदेश / महाराष्ट्र बॉर्डर मार्ग के तालुक- 
प्रभातपट्टन के कि.मी. 7+600 से 23+ 925 कि.मी., अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से SaaS 
अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "18 जून 2024" 
को "पत्रिका" और "19 जून 2024 " को "दैनिक भास्कर" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 
3घ की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 

और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती 
है कि इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक 
रूप से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी |

S.O. 229(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of

1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention 
to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for Building(widening/2lane 
with paved shoulder/4lane etc,) Maintenance, management and operation of NH347A in the stretch of land 
from Total ch. Km. 0+000 to 23+925 Km. (Multai- Prabhatpattan to MP-MH Border Road) Teh.

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Patrika” dated 18 June 
2024 and “Dainik Bhaskar” both dated 19 June 2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said 
Act; 

And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered 

and settled the same appropriately; 

And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority 
has submitted its report to the Central Government; 

Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the 
powers conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that the land specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government 
hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said 
Schedule shall vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the 3" January,2025 


S.O. 230(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highways, 95(E) Dated:08/05/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 
3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of !956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (Widening/Four laning etc.,) Maintenance, management and 
operation of National Highway No.342 in the stretch of land from Km. 0/000 to Km.32/000 (Mudigubba to Puttaparthy 
Section) in the District of Sri Satya Sai in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH 
And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Andhra Jyothi” and “Hans 
India” both dated 2/05/2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 
And whereas no objections has been received from any person by the Competent Authority; 
And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the 13th January, 2025 


S.O. 234(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 2551 Dated:02/07/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of 
NH75 in the stretch of land from Km. 39.6 to Km. 49.38 (DLAO PALAMU) in the district of PALAMU in the state 
of JHARKHAND 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Khabar Mantra” and “Times Of 


India” both dated 13.07.2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 


settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 


submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 


specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 


vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा ३ घ

पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

(Protection) Act, 1986 against any person who contravenes the provisions of this notification. 


The Monitoring Committee may invite a representative or expert from the Department, a 
representative from industry associations or stakeholders to assist the committee in its deliberations 
depending on the requirements on a case to case basis. 


The Monitoring Committee shall submit the annual action taken report of its activities for the period 
up to the 315 March of every year to the Chief Wildlife Warden in pro forma specified in 
Annexure- III by the 30th June of that year.

S.O. 196(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Section 20A of the Railway Act, 1989 (24 
of 1989) & Railway Amendment Act, 2008 (11 of 2008) (Hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central 
Government after being satisfied that for the public purpose the land situated at District Hathras of the state of Uttar 
Pradesh, the brief description of which has given in the Schedule annexed hereto is required for the purpose of 
execution of the North Central Railway's Special Railway project, namely Raising of Speed to 160kmph/200kmph on 
existing New Delhi-Howrah route (incl. Kanpur-Lucknow) in the district of Hathras in the State of Uttar Pradesh, for 
Traction Sub-Station & Sub Sectioning and Paralleling Post hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within thirty days from the date of publication of this notification 
in the Newspapers, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under Section 20D 
sub- section (1) of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority namely, Sub Divisional Magistrate, 
Sasni/SLAO Hathras Uttar Pradesh in writing and shall set out the grounds there of and the Competent Authority shall 
give the objector an opportunity of being heard either in person or by legal practitioner and may, after hearing such

authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections.

9.0. 243(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 886(E) Dated:23/02/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for construction of Maintenance, management and operation of NH167A in the stretch of land 
from Km. 35.200 to Km. 81.690 (Vodarevu-Narasaraopet Piduguralla Section) in the district of Palnadu in the state 
of ANDHRA PRADESH ; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Andhra Prabha(telugu)” and “The 
Hindu (English)” both dated 01.03.2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


[भाग 1---खण्ड 3(ii)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 23 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

2, In the Legal Metrology (General) Rules, 20I, in the Eighth Schedule, after PART IX,

“PART X 
RADAR EQUIPMENT FOR MEASURING SPEED OF VEHICLES 


l. Scope.- 
This Part shall be applicable to microwave Doppler radar equipment used for the 
measurement of traffic speed on roads, (hereinafter referred to as the "radar") and the radar 
shall conform to the conditions specified in this Part. 

2. Rules of correct operation.- 
(.) Radars shall be installed and used in accordance with the instructions approved with the 
instrument at the time of model approval (hereinafter referred to as the instructions). 
(2) Certainty of vehicle identification,- 

(0) The construction of the radar, including the internal logic of the measurement process,

indicated speed shall not be attributed to the wrong vehicle even where vehicles are 
passing or overtaking or when the radar is mounted on a moving vehicle. 


(ii) The radar shall have a direction discriminator (single sideband device), provided as it 
has limited effect and stability it does not offer a complete solution and additional 
device shall be used. 


(ii) In absence of use of any additional device, the radar shall invalidate its own result 
when two vehicles with different speeds pass simultaneously through the radiation 
beam.

measurement shall be possible in those parts of the antenna lobe where an incorrect angle 
of incidence may result in relative measurement errors greater than + 2 %. 

(iv) Errors resulting from a tilting of the radar in relation to the surface of the road 
shall be considered.

Time span for indication,-

positive action and no event or action during this time shall influence the result or have

(6) Recording devices,- 


(i) If the radar records the results of measurement, the record shall indicate the date and 
time of the measurement, the measured speed and the vehicle's direction of travel. 


(ii) The record shall indicate the sensitivity setting of the radar. 


(iii) If the identity of the vehicle is not made recognisable by a photograph, the records 
shall provide for its immediate identification in writing. 


(iv) The record shall indicate that checks as stated in sub-paragraph (9) have been

(v) If a camera is used, the correct relationship between the direction of radiation and that 
of the optical axis of the camera shall be ensured by positive mechanical links or by the 
operations described in the instructions and the correct aiming of the system shall be 
verified from pictures. 


(7) Automatic and autonomous radar,- 


(0) Radars designed for operations that cannot be continuously verified by an officer for 
satisfactory performance shall ensure a "near to certainty" level of confidence that the 
error of each transmitted result shall be within the permissible limits. 


(ii) The manufacturer shall explain in the instructions, the measures taken to satisfy the 
condition in clause (6). 


(iii) The level of confidence shall take uncertainties of measurement into account including 
a possible single failure in the whole instrument and it shall be confirmed by the model 
approval authority. 


(iv) The level of confidence, if estimated by statistical methods, shall be at least 99.8 %. 
Note:- The permanent automatic checking of the instrument's essential operations shall be 
done in accordance with clause (ii) of sub-paragraph (4) of paragraph 3 of this Part. As it is an 
unattended operation, the redundant measurement techniques such as taking two pictures of the 
vehicle separated by a specified time interval shall be used. 


(8) Automatic exclusion of inaccurate results when the power voltage varies,- 


Speed indications shall be inhibited when the power voltage varies beyond the limits at which 
the allowable errors may be surpassed. 


(9) Overall function test device,- 


(i) The radar shall incorporate some means of simulating a measurement that is 
independent of the measuring circuits, and by which, at switch-on and additionally at 
the will of the operator, the instrument shall be checked. 


(ii) The means specified under clause (i) shall indicate at least every non intermittent 
failure of the low-frequency and result-handling circuits, including circuits necessary 
to comply with clause (ii) of sub-paragraph (4) of paragraph 3 and the functioning and 
accuracy of indication. 


(iii) The records shall confirm that these tests have been performed. 


(iv) The requirements under clauses (i), Gi) and (iii) shall not apply if undetected 
intermittent or permanent failures may be excluded.

(l) Indicators and speed range,- 


In radars without data recording, the indicators shall be readable by two operators 
simultaneously in lighting conditions corresponding to the conditions of use for which the 
instrument is suitable according to the instructions provided with the instrument and the speed 
range shall include at least the range (30 kilometer per hour to 50 kilometer per hour). 


(2) Mechanical strength,- 


The radar shall be solidly built and the materials shall be chosen to ensure sufficient strength 
and stability of the radar. 


(3) Resistance to extremes of climate,- 
(0) When out of service, radars shall be capable of withstanding ambient temperatures 
of — 25 °C to + 70 °C. 


(ii) The manufacturer shall indicate the ambient temperature limits between which the

temperature limits are passed, radars designed for unattended operation shall 
automatically go out of service and the range of ambient temperature shall be 
between 0°C to +50°C. 


(iii) The radar shall be insensitive to relative humidity of the ambient air both under 
static conditions of storage and in service as specified in clause (i) and (ii). 


(iv) The parts of the radar that are exposed to the weather shall be dust proof and splash 
proof when all accessories are fixed.

Foreign Exchange Management (Foreign Currency Accounts by a person resident in India) (Fifth Amendment) 
Regulations, 2025 
No. FEMA 10(R)(5)/2025-RB.—In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 9 and clause (e) of 
sub-section (2) of section 47 of the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (42 of 1999), the Reserve Bank of India 
makes the following amendments to the Foreign Exchange Management (Foreign Currency Accounts by a person 
resident in India) Regulations, 2015 [Notification No. FEMA 10(R)/2015-RB dated January 21, 2016] (hereinafter 
referred to as 116 principal regulations’), namely: 
1. Short Title and Commencement: - 
(i) These regulations may be called the Foreign Exchange Management (Foreign Currency Accounts by a person 
resident in India) (Fifth Amendment) Regulations, 2025. 
(ii) They shall come into force from the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. In the principal regulations, in regulation 5, after sub-regulation (C) the following sub-regulation (CA) shall be 
inserted , namely:- 
“CA. A person resident in India, being an exporter, may open, hold and maintain a Foreign Currency Account with a 
bank outside India, for realisation of full export value and advance remittance received by the exporter towards export 
of goods or services. Funds in this account may be utilised by the exporter for paying for its imports into India or 
repatriated into India within a period not exceeding the end of the next month from the date of receipt of the funds 
after adjusting for forward commitments, provided that the realisation and repatriation requirements as specified in 
Regulation 9 of Foreign Exchange Management (Export of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2015 are also met.”

Notification No. FEMA 5(R)(5)/2025-RB.—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (2) of

Bank of India makes the following amendment in the Foreign Exchange Management (Deposit) Regulations, 2016

(Notification No. FEMA 5 (R) /2016-RB dated April 01, 2016) (hereinafter referred to as 116 principal regulations’), 
namely:- 


1. Short Title and Commencement: - 


(i) These regulations may be called the Foreign Exchange Management (Deposit) (Fifth Amendment) 
Regulations, 2025. 


(ii) They shall come into force from the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. In the principal regulations, within sub-regulation (4), of regulation 5, after the words “authorised dealer in India” 
the words “or its branch outside India” shall be inserted. 


3. In the principal regulations, after regulation 8, the following shall be inserted namely: - 
“9. Transfer of funds between repatriable Rupee accounts: - 


Notwithstanding anything contained in these regulations, the transfer of funds, for all bona fide transactions, between 
repatriable Rupee accounts maintained in accordance with these regulations is permitted.” 


4. In the principal regulations in schedule 4, the existing paragraph 1 shall be substituted by the following namely:- 


“A person resident outside India, having business interest in India, may open a Special Non-Resident Rupee Account 
(SNRR account), with an authorised dealer in India or its branch outside India for the purpose of putting through 
permissible current and capital account transactions with a person resident in India in accordance with the rules and 
regulations framed under the Act, and for putting through any transaction with a person resident outside India. 


Explanation: A unit in an International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) under section 18 of the Special Economic 
Zones Act, 2005 may open an SNRR account with an authorised dealer in India (outside IFSC) for its business related 
transactions outside IFSC.” 


5. In the principal regulations within paragraph 2 of schedule 4, the words “Indian bank” shall be substituted by 
“A bank”. 


6. In the principal regulations, in schedule 4, the existing paragraph 8 shall be substituted by the following namely:- 


“The tenure of the SNRR account shall be concurrent to the tenure of the contract / period of operation / the business 
of the account holder.” 


7. In the principal regulations, within paragraphs 9, 11 and 12 of schedule 4, after the words “SNRR account” the 
words “in India” shall be inserted. 


8. In the principal regulations, within paragraph 13 of schedule 4, after the words “‘account holder” the words “having 
the SNRR account in India” shall be inserted.

कोई स्टार्ट-अप कंपनी, जो भारत से बाहर के निवासी किसी व्यक्ति को परिवर्तनीय नोट निर्गमित करती है, वह प्रतिफल राशि बैंकिंग 


चैनलों के माध्यम से आवक विप्रेषण के रूप में अथवा संबंधित व्यक्ति द्वारा विदेशी मुद्रा प्रबंध (जमा) विनियमावली, 2016 के अनुसरण 
में बनाए रखे गए किसी प्रत्यावर्तनीय विदेशी मुद्रा या रुपया खाते से डेबिट के माध्यम से प्राप्त कर सकती है। पुनर्भुगतान अथवा बिक्री 
पर प्राप्त आय को भारत से बाहर विप्रेषित किया जा सकता है अथवा उसे विदेशी मुद्रा प्रबंध (जमा) विनियमावली, 2016 के अनुसरण 


में संबंधित व्यक्ति द्वारा रखे गए किसी प्रत्यावर्तनीय विदेशी मुद्रा या रुपया खाते में जमा किया जा सकता है।”

“स्पष्टीकरण: इस विनियमावली के प्रयोजन हेतु, "बैंकिंग चैनलों" के अंतर्गत विशेष रुपया वोस्ट्रो खाते सहित ऐसा कोई भी रुपया वोस्ट्रो

विनियम 7 (1) में दी गयी है।”

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 15th January, 2025 


S.O. 284(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH146 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 108.115 to Km. 149.141 (SDM office, Rahatgarh) in the district of SAGAR in the state of 
MADHYA PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub - Divisional Officer, Rahatgarh 
in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of 
being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

9.0. 267(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, S.O.No. 557(E) Dated: 06/02/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), Maintenance, 
management and operation of NH56 in the stretch of land from Km. 0+000 To 27+500 Km. to (Jobat-Ambua-Gujrat 
Border Road) in the district of ALIRAJPUR in the state of MADHYA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Patrika” and “Vinay Ujala” both 
dated 02 March 2024 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 


24 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning

And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

का.आ. 273(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 2817(ई) तारीख 18/07/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग ॥, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) A प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा कर्नाटक राज्य के उत्तर Has जिले में NHC के 
कि.मी. 93.7 से कि.मी. 283.3 (सक्षम प्राधिकारी NH-66 & एसी कार्यालय कुमटा) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण 
(चौड़ा करने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में 
विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी; 

और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "01/08/2024" 
को "वर्तभारती" और "द टाइम्स ऑफ़ इण्डिया" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

New Delhi, the 15th January, 2025 


S.O. 273(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, S.O 2817(E) Dated:18/07/2024, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of 
NH66 in the stretch of land from Km. 93.7 to Km. 283.3 (The office of the Competent Authority NH-66 & AC Office 
Kumta) in the district of UTTAR KANNAD in the state of KARNATAKA; 


[भाग 1---खण्ड 3(ii)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 11 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Vatha Bharathi” and “The Times 
Of India” both dated 01/08/2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 5" January,2025 


S.O. 27(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highways, 044(E) Dated:05/03/2024, published in the Gazette of India, 
Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section () of section 3A of the 
National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central 
Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said 
notification for (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning  etc.,) Maintenance, 
management and operation of NH333A in the stretch of land from Km. 42.2 to Km. 94.9 (Collectorate) 
in the district of PAKUR in the state of JHARKHAND, hereby declares its intention to acquire such 
land. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Hindustan” and 
“Prabhat Khabar” on dated 0.04.2024 , .04.2024 and in “Dainik Bhaskar” and “Dainik Jagran” 
on dated .04.2024 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, 
considered and settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section () of section 3D of the said Act, the competent 
authority has submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of 
the powers conferred by the sub-section () of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government 
hereby declares that the land specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid 
purpose; 

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central 
Government hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land 
specified in the said Schedule shall vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all 
encumbrances.

पे-मैट्रिक्स में पदों की संख्या, वर्गीकरण और स्तर:- 


पदों की संख्या, उसका वर्गीकरण और उससे जुड़े पे-मैट्रिक्स में स्तर अनुसूची | में निहित संबंधित पदों में निर्दिष्ट 
होगा। ग्रुप AY के रूप में पदों का वर्गीकरण केंद्र सरकार के वेतन स्तर में समान श्रेणियों के अनुरूप होगा। 

भर्ती मानदंड:- 

सभी पदों के लिए न्यूनतम शैक्षणिक योग्यता अनुसूची । में निर्दिष्ट के अनुसार होगी। संबंधित पद के लिए 
आवश्यक आरआईपीएएनएस के संबंध में गैर संकाय के हित के संबंधित क्षेत्रों में शैक्षिक योग्यता के लिए निर्दिष्ट 
अनुशासन, पदों के विज्ञापित होने से पहले अनुसूची | में दिया जाएगा। मान्यता प्राप्त विश्वविद्यालय और नियामक 
निकायों की शैक्षिक योग्यता, यथास्थिति, केवल स्वीकार किया जाएगा। शैक्षिक योग्यता के संबंध में किसी भी 
संदेह की स्थिति में, नियुक्ति प्राधिकारी का निर्णय अंतिम और बाध्यकारी होगा। 

सभी पदों के लिए आवश्यक अनुभव अनुसूची | में निर्दिष्ट अनुसार होगा। पद के लिए अपेक्षित अनुभव निर्धारित 
करने की निर्णायक तिथि अभ्यर्थी से आवेदन प्राप्त करने की अंतिम तिथि होगी। 

भर्ती अनुसूची । में निर्धारित अनुसार की जाएगी। जब भी पद सीधी भर्ती द्वारा भरा जाना हो, तो पदों का 
विज्ञापन आरआईपीएएनएस की वेबसाइट और समाचार पत्रों में ऐसे उचित तरीकों से किया जाएगा जो संस्थान 
प्राधिकरण उचित समझे। बड़ी संख्या में आवेदन प्राप्त होने की स्थिति में, निदेशक एक स्क्रीनिंग कमेटी का गठन 
कर सकते हैं, जो अभ्यर्थियों का चयन करेगी। 

सीधी भर्ती के मामले में, पद के लिए नौकरी की आवश्यकता को ध्यान में रखते हुए चयन समिति द्वारा तय किए 


गए विभिन्न मापदंडों के लिए विशिष्ट अंक देकर चयन पारदर्शी होगा। सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा गठित चयन समिति 
सभी पात्र अभ्यर्थियों के साक्षात्कार, जैसा आवश्यक हो, आयोजित करेगी। 


पदधारी के प्रतिनियुक्ति या लंबी बीमारी या अध्ययन अवकाश या अन्य परिस्थितियों में एक वर्ष या उससे अधिक

अवधि के लिए शुरू में परिवीक्षा पर रहेंगे। परिवीक्षा अवधि के अंत में, संस्थान प्राधिकारी द्वारा उम्मीदवार के 
प्रदर्शन का मूल्यांकन किया जाएगा ताकि यह तय किया जा सके कि परिवीक्षा अवधि के दौरान उम्मीदवार का 
प्रदर्शन संतोषजनक रहा है या नहीं। यदि उसका प्रदर्शन संतोषजनक पाया जाता है, तो उसे परिवीक्षा पूरी होने 
पर नियमित नियुक्ति के लिए पुष्टि की जाएगी। 


उम्मीदवार के पास अनुसूची | में निर्दिष्ट न्यूनतम योग्यता और अनुभव होने के अधीन, अन्य केंद्र सरकार/राज्य 
सरकार के उम्मीदवारों को प्रतिनियुक्ति के आधार पर लिया जा सकता है। प्रतिनियुक्ति की अवधि तीन वर्ष की 
होगी जिसे निदेशक द्वारा सेवा की आवश्यकताओं के अनुसार ऋणदाता विभाग की सहमति से पाँच वर्ष तक 
बढ़ाया जा सकता है। 


अयोग्यता:- 
कोई भी व्यक्ति : 


(क) जिसने ऐसे व्यक्ति के साथ विवाह किया है या विवाह का अनुबंध किया है जिसका पति या पत्नी जीवित है, 
या 


(a) जिसने अपने पति या पत्नी के जीवित रहते हुए किसी अन्य व्यक्ति के साथ विवाह किया है या अनुबंध किया 
है, उक्त पदों में से किसी पर नियुक्ति के लिए अपात्र होगा; 


बशर्ते कि आरआईपीएएनएस, यदि संतुष्ट हो कि ऐसे व्यक्ति और विवाह के दूसरे पक्ष पर लागू व्यक्तिगत कानून के 
तहत इस तरह के विवाह की अनुमति है और ऐसा करने के लिए अन्य आधार हैं, तो किसी भी व्यक्ति को इस 
नियम के संचालन से छूट दी जा सकती है। 


व्याख्या:- 

जहां इन नियमों के किसी भी प्रावधान की व्याख्या के संबंध में कोई संदेह उत्पन्न होता है, मामला नियुक्ति 
प्राधिकारी को भेजा जाएगा जिसका निर्णय अंतिम होगा। 

छूट देने की शक्ति :- 


जहां आरआईपीएएनएस की विधिवत गठित चयन समिति की राय है कि ऐसा करना आवश्यक या समीचीन है, 


यह लिखित रूप में दर्ज किए जाने वाले कारणों से हो सकता है, अनुसूची | में उल्लिखित किसी भी वर्ग या श्रेणी के

Short Title and commencement: - 


These rules may be called the Recruitment Rules of Group C Non Faculty Posts (Multi-Tasking Staff), 
Regional Institute of Paramedical & Nursing Sciences, Aizawl, Mizoram, 2024. 
They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


The number of posts, classification and level in the Pay Matrix: - 


The number of posts, its classification and the level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in 
respective posts as contained in Schedule I. The classification of posts as Group B will correspond to similar 
categories in the Pay Level of Central Government. 

Recruitment Norms: - 


The minimum educational qualification for all the posts shall be as specified in Schedule I. The specified 
discipline for educational qualification in related areas of interest of the faculty in respect of RIPANS, 
required for the post concerned, will be as given in Schedule I, before the posts are advertised. Educational 
qualifications of recognized University and regulating Statutory Bodies, as the case may be, will only be 
accepted. In case of any doubt regarding educational qualification, the decision of Appointing Authority will 
be final and binding. 

The experience required for all the posts shall as specified in Schedule I. The crucial date for determining the 
experience required for the post shall be the closing date for receipt of application from candidates. 
Recruitment shall be made by direct recruitment, as prescribed in Schedule I. Whenever the posts are to be 
filled up by direct recruitment, the posts shall be advertised in the website of RIPANS and newspapers by 
such appropriate methods as the Institute authority deems fit. In case of receipt of large number of 
applications, the Director may constitute a Screening Committee, which will short-list the candidates. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selection shall be transparent by giving specific marks for various 
parameters decided by the Selection Committee, keeping in view the job requirement for the post. The

as may be required. 


Vacancies caused by the incumbent being away on deputation or long illness or study leave or under other 
circumstances, for duration of one year or more, can be filled on deputation/short term contract. 

Age limit for direct recruitments: - 

The upper age limit for direct recruitment in each category of post shall be as specified in Schedule I. The 
upper age limit in respect of Schedule Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes and the other 
special categories of persons etc, shall be relaxable in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time. 


Unless otherwise specified in the Recruitment Rules, age relaxation of 5 years will be allowed for personnel 
serving in Central/State Government and Autonomous Institutions of Central & State Governments. 


The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the closing date for receipt of application from 
candidates. 


Method of Recruitment: 


The method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be 
specified in column 5 to 13 of the said Schedule. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selected candidates, from the date of assuming the duties will be on 
probation initially for a minimum period as specified in Schedule I. At the end of probation period, the 
candidate’s performance will be assessed by the Institute authority to decide if the candidate’s performance 
during the probation period has been satisfactory or otherwise. If his/her performance is found to be 
satisfactory, he/she will be confirmed for regular appointment on completion of probation. 


Subject to the candidate having minimum qualification and experience as specified in Schedule I, candidates 
from other Central Government/State Government can be taken on deputation basis. The period of deputation 
shall be for a period of three years which may be extended by the Director up to five years in the exigencies 
of service taking the consent of the lending department. 


Disqualification: - 
No person: 
(a) Who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or 


(b) Who having a spouse living, has entered in or contracted a marriage with any other person, shall be 


eligible for appointment to any of the said posts; 


Provided that RIPANS may, if satisfied that such a marriage is permissible under the personal law applicable 
to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 


person from the operation of this rule. 


Interpretation: - 

Where any doubt arises as to the interpretation of any of the provisions of these rules, the matter shall be 
referred to Appointing Authority whose decision shall be final. 

Power to relax: - 

Where the duly constituted Selection Committee of RIPANS is of the opinion that it is necessary or 
expedient to do so, it may for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with 
respect to any class or category of posts mentioned in Schedule I. This will be subject to acceptance of the 
Appointing Authority. 

Saving: - 

Nothing in these rules shall affect reservations, relaxation of age limit and other concessions required to be 
provided to candidates belonging to the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Ex- 
Servicemen and other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central

202”and “Times city English” dated “Ol August 2024”; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall

राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 59O(E) तारीख 12/02/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग II,

को "विजया कर्नाटक" और "डेक्कन Fares" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और उसका 
उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि इस

New Delhi, the 16th January, 2025 


S.O. 311(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highways, 599(E) Dated: 12/02/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part 
II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 
(48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire 
the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building ( widening two lane with 
paved shoulders / four laning etc.), maintenance, management and operation of National Highway No - 
173 in the stretch of land from Km. 67.000 to Km. 104.00 (Kadur Hosadurga section) in the district of 
CHIKKAMAGALURU in the state of KARNATAKA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Vijaya Karnataka” and 
“Deccan Herald” both dated 18th February 2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered 
and settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority 
has submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the 
powers conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that the land specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government 
hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said

संख्या 59 के किमी 44.00 से 51.200 किमी तक के भू-खण्ड के निर्माण (टिटलागढ़ शहर बाईपास निर्माण और मिसिंग 
लिंक का 2-लेन पेव्ड शोल्डर सहित चौड़ीकरण) अनुरक्षण, प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन केलिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध 
अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "15.11.2024" 
को उड़िया दैनिक "द संवाद" और अंग्रेजी दैनिक "=z इंडियन एक्सप्रेस" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ;

उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 16th January, 2025 


9.0. 310(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, S.O. 3977(E) Dated:18/09/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for construction of (Titilagarh town Bypass and widening of missing link with two 
lane with paved shoulder), maintenance, management and operation of NH-59 in the stretch of land from Km. 44.00 to 
Km. 51.200 in the district of BALANGIR in the state of ODISHA. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in Odia daily “The Sambad” and 
English daily “The Indian Express” both dated 15.11.2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 261(E) तारीख 18/01/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग II,

(देवधर-सारठ-मधुपुर सेक्शन ) तक के भूखण्ड के निर्माण (चार लेन का बनाने/चौड़ा करने ) , ATLA, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन 
के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 26.01.2024 को 
इंडियन पंच , हिंदुस्तान और जदीद भारत में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और उसका 
उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 16th January, 2025 


S.O. 304(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National 
Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after 
being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule 
below, is required for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, 
management and operation of NH548B in the stretch of land from Km. 42.7 to Km. 69.1 (Sub Divisional 
Office, Tal.Pathri, District Pathari) in the district of PARBHANI in the state of MAHARASHTRA, hereby 
declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of 
this notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub- 
section(1) of section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Officer LA 
Officer Pathri in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the 
objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all 
such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, 
by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall 
be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and 
can be inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 16th January, 2025 


S.O. 303(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for 
building Widening / Re-construction to Two Lane with paved Shoulder of NH-143AG from Km 37.400 (Design 
chainage) to Km 85.560 (Design Chainage) Bero - Khunti Section (in Ranchi district from Km 33.25 to Km 58.05) 
in the state of Jharkhand, maintenance, management and operation of NH143AG in the stretch of land from Km. 
37.400 to Km. 85.560 (DLAO RANCHI) in the district of RANCHI in the state of JHARKHAND, hereby declares its 
intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, District Land Acquisition Officer, 
Ranchi in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow 
the objections.

पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा () के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क परिवहन 
और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 4284 तारीख 72/03/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, 
भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड () में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा पंजाब राज्य के लुधियाना जिले में NH205K के कि.मी. 0 से 
कि.मी. 26 तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ा करने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के 
लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "47.03.2024 " 
को "द टाइम्स ऑफ़ इण्डिया" और "जगबानी" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और उसका 
उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (॥) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 

और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप से 
केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी |

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the l6th January, 2025 


S.O. 307(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 284 Dated:2/03/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(ii) issued under sub-section (.) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH205K in 
the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 26 in the district of LUDHIANA in the state of PUNJAB 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Times 0 India” and “Jagbani” 
both dated /7.03.2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 4436 तारीख 10/10/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण,

कार्यालय, मदुरै - 625 020) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ा करने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन 
और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का asta करने के अपने आशय की 
घोषणा की थी ; 

और जबकि उक्त अधिसूचना का सार "डेली थांथी" और "द हिंदू" दोनों दिनांक 09.11.2024 में प्रकाशित किया 
गया है; उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ए की उपधारा (3) के तहत; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और उसका 
उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 

और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप से 
केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

से कि.मी.129.775 (गोधरा शामलाजी रोड के बगल में ग्राउंड फ्लोर, जिला सेवा सदन) तक के भूखण्ड पर टोल प्लाजा के

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 16th January, 2025 


S.O. 312(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 4060(E) Dated:19/09/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for construction of Toll Plaza Maintenance, management and operation of NH-168G in the stretch 
of land from Km. 104.4 to Km. 129.775 (Ground floor , jilla seva sadan , beside godhara shamalaji road) in the district 
of ARVALLI in the state of GUJARAT; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in“The Indian 
Express” and “Sandesh” both dated 09-10-2024 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

The number of posts, classification and level in the Pay Matrix: - 


The number of posts, its classification and the level in the Pay Matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in 
respective posts as contained in Schedule I. The classification of posts as Group B will correspond to similar 


categories in the Pay Level of Central Government. 
Recruitment Norms:— 


The minimum educational qualification for all the posts shall be as specified in Schedule I. The specified 
discipline for educational qualification in related areas of interest of the faculty in respect of RIPANS, required 
for the post concerned, will be as given in Schedule I, before the posts are advertised. Educational qualifications 
of recognized University and regulating Statutory Bodies, as the case may be, will only be accepted. In case of 


any doubt regarding educational qualification, the decision of Appointing Authority will be final and binding. 


The experience required for all the posts shall as specified in Schedule I. The crucial date for determining the 


experience required for the post shall be the closing date for receipt of application from candidates. 


Recruitment shall be made by direct recruitment, as prescribed in Schedule I. Whenever the posts are to be 
filled up by direct recruitment, the posts shall be advertised in the website of RIPANS and newspapers by such 
appropriate methods as the Institute authority deems fit. In case of receipt of large number of applications, the 


Director may constitute a Screening Committee, which will short-list the candidates. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selection shall be transparent by giving specific marks for various parameters 
decided by the Selection Committee, keeping in view the job requirement for the post. The Selection 
Committee as constituted by competent authority will hold interviews of the all-eligible candidates, as may be 


required. 


Vacancies caused by the incumbent being away on deputation or long illness or study leave or under other 


circumstances, for duration of one year or more, can be filled on deputation/short term contract. 
Age limit for direct recruitments:— 


The upper age limit for direct recruitment in each category of post shall be as specified in Schedule I. The 
upper age limit in respect of Schedule Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes and the other special 
categories of persons etc, shall be relaxable in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government 


from time to time. 


Unless otherwise specified in the Recruitment Rules, age relaxation of 5 years will be allowed for personnel 


serving in Central/State Government and Autonomous Institutions of Central & State Governments. 


The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the closing date for receipt of application from 


candidates. 
Method of Recruitment:— 


The method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be specified 


in column 5 to |3 of the said Schedule. 


In case of direct recruitment, the selected candidates, from the date of assuming the duties will be on probation 
initially for a minimum period as specified in Schedule I. At the end of probation period, the candidate’s 
performance will be assessed by the Institute authority to decide if the candidate’s performance during the 
probation period has been satisfactory or otherwise. If his/her performance is found to be satisfactory, he/she 


will be confirmed for regular appointment on completion of probation.

6. Interpretation: — 
Where any doubt arises as to the interpretation of any of the provisions of these rules, the matter shall be 
referred to Appointing Authority whose decision shall be final. 

7. Power to relax:— 
Where the duly constituted Selection Committee of RIPANS is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient 
to do so, it may for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to 
any class or category of posts mentioned in Schedule I. This will be subject to acceptance of the Appointing 
Authority. 

8. Saving:— 

Nothing in these rules shall affect reservations, relaxation of age limit and other concessions required to be 
provided to candidates belonging to the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Ex- 
Servicemen and other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central 
Government from time to time in this regard. The posts filled earlier will not be affected by these Recruitment 
Rules, which are being notified now. The job descriptions pertaining to various posts would be issued 
separately by RIPANS as an Office Order.

NOTIFICATION 
Jaipur, the 16th January, 2025 


S.O. 297(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of 
Railway (North Western Railway Construction), S.O. No. 1059 (A) dated 4 MARCH , 2024 
published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part-II, Section 3, Sub Section (ii) on dated 5 
MARCH, 2024 (hereinafter referred to as the said notification) under sub-section (i) of section 
20A of the Railways Act, 2008 (11 of 2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central 
Government, declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the 
said notification for execution, maintenance and operation of the Special Railway Project, namely 
"Taranga Hill -Abu Road Via Ambaji (116.65 km ) NEW BG LINE Project District- Mehsana in 
the State of Gujarat. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers 
namely “Divya Bhaskar“and “Sandesh” on date 10 March ,2024 under sub section (4) of section 
20A of the said Act; 


And, whereas, no objection were received by the Competent Authority within due time. 


And, whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the 
Competent Authority has submitted its report to the Central Government. 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise 
of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government 
hereby declares that the lands specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the 
aforesaid purpose; 


And, further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central 
Government hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the 
land specified in the Schedule annexed here to shall vest absolutely in the Central Government 
free from all encumbrances.

(Construction Organization) 
NOTIFICATION 
Gorakhpur, the l6th January, 2025 


9.0. 300(E).— Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (North 
Eastern Railway, Construction Origination), Notification number, S.O. 4996(E) dated 2] November 2024 published 
in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated |l September 2024 (hereinafter referred to 
as the said notification) and issued under sub-section (l) of section 20A of the Railways (Amendment) Act, 2008 (I 
of 2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land 
specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and 
operation of Special Railway Project, namely Khalilabad-Bahraich New Line Railway project (240.66 km.) in Tehsil 
Bahraich of Bahraich District in the State of Uttar Pradesh. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely ''Hindustan" 
and ''The Times of India'' Dated 30 November 2024 under sub section (4) of section 204 of the said Act; 


And whereas, the competent Authority has resolved all the objection received in this project against the 
notification. And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority, and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (l) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands 
specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 301(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने रेल अधिनियम, 1989 (1989 का 24) एवं रेलवे (संशोधन) (जिसे इसमे इसके 
पश्चात Sat अधिनियम कहा गया S|) की धारा 20 'क' के उप धारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह समाधान 
हो जाने के पश्चात की लोक प्रयोजन के लिए, वह भूमि जिसका संक्षिप्त विवरण इसमें उपाबद्द अनुसूची में दिया गया है। विशेष 
रेल परियोजना अर्थात खलीलाबाद-बहराईच नई रेल लाईन परियोजना (240.66 किमी0) के उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य के बहराईच 
जिले के बहराईच तहसील में निष्पादन, अनुरक्षण, प्रबंन्ध और प्रचालन के लिए आपेक्षित है, ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के आशय 
की घोषणा करती है। 


उक्त भूमि में हितबद्द कोई व्यक्ति राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से तीस दिन के भीतर उक्त अधिनियम 
कि धारा 20 घ की उप धारा (1) के अधीन उपयुक्त प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के अर्जन और उपयोग के सम्बन्ध में आक्षेप कर 
सकेगा। 


प्रत्येक ऐसा आक्षेप सक्षम प्राधिकारी अर्थात्‌ विशेष भूमि अध्यापित अधिकारी, जिला बहराईच उत्तर प्रदेश को लिखित 
में किया जायेगा और उसके आधार उपवर्णित करेगा और सक्षम प्रधिकारी आक्षेपकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रुप से या विधि व्यवसायी के 
माध्यम से सुनवाई का अवसर प्रदान करेगा और ऐसे आक्षेपो की सुनवाई करने तथा ऐसे कोई जॉच करने के पश्चात यदि कोई 
हो, जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे, आदेश द्वारा या तो आक्षेपो को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या अननुज्ञात करेगा।

NOTIFICATION 
Gorakhpur, the 16th January, 2025 


S.O. 301(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Section 20A of the Railways Act,1989 (24 
of 1989) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the public 
purpose, the land, the brief description of which has been given in schedule annexed hereto, is required for purpose of 
execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely Khalilabad -Bahraich New 
railway line project (240.66 Km ) in the Tehsil Bahraich of Bahraich District in State of Uttar Pradesh hereby 
declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section (1) of section 20D of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority namely, Special Land Acquisition officer, 
Bahraich Uttar Pradesh in writing and shall set out the grounds there of, and the Competent Authority shall give the 
objector the opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner and may, after hearing such objections 
and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allowor 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 20D of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected by the 
interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

परीक्षण (आईएनटीटी - एटी) (जो संस्थान के सदस्यों के लिए खुली है) नीचे दी गई तिथियों और स्थानों (केवल भारत में 
केंद्र) पर आयोजित की जाएँगी, बशर्ते कि नीचे उल्लिखित प्रत्येक स्थान से पर्याप्त संख्या में उम्मीदवार उपस्थित होने की

. नर्स प्रैक्टिशनर इन एनेस्थेसिया को दक्षताएं (आईसीएन, 2020 से रूपांतरित) 


व्यापक आंकलन, नैदानिक प्रक्रियाओं, पेरी-एनेस्थेसिया जटिलताओं के प्रबंधन से संबंधित जानकारी प्राप्त करता है। 

जब रोगी जटिल और »या अस्थिर वातावरण में होते हैं, तो रोगी सुरक्षा में उन्‍नतत कौशल तथा दक्षताओं को लागू करता है 
और उन्हें अनुकूलित करता है। 

पेरी-एनेस्थेटिक प्रबंधन में ठोस उन्‍नत नैदानिक तर्क और निर्णय लागू करता है। 

रोगी देखभाल के आंकलन, प्रबंधन और निरूपण में महत्वपूर्ण सोच का उपयोग करता है। 

आंकलन, निदान, प्रबंधन का दस्तावेजीकरण करता है और रोगी की साझेदारी में उपचार तथा अनुवर्ती देखभाल की 
निगरानी करता है। 

संस्थागत प्रोटोकॉल के अनुसार औषधियों और उपचारों का प्रशासन करता है। 

चिकित्सीय संबंधों को शुरू करने, विकसित करने और बंद करने के लिए लागू संचार, परामर्श, पक्ष-समर्थन और 
पारस्परिक कौशल का उपयोग करता है। 

देखभाल की निरंतरता बनाए रखने के लिए अन्य स्वास्थ्य सेवा कर्मियों से रेफरल लेता है और रेफर करता है। 

जहां भी अधिकृत हो, स्वतंत्र रूप से अभ्यास करता है। 


. अन्य स्वास्थ्य सेवा कर्मियों और अन्य लोगों से परामर्श लेता है और उन्हें परामर्श देता है। 
. रोगी के हित में ओआर कर्मियों और शल्य-चिकित्सा दल के सदस्यों के साथ मिलकर काम करता है। 
. वर्तमान वैज्ञानिक साक्ष्य पर आधारित और रोगी, परिजनों तथा समुदाय के स्वास्थ्य प्रबंधन में शामिल अभ्यास विकसित 


करता है। 


. स्वतंत्र और अंतर-पेशेवर शोध के माध्यम से देखभाल की सुरक्षा, दक्षता और प्रभावशीलता में सुधार करने के लिए

. एपीएन भूमिका और जिम्मेदारी के सभी पहलुओं में नैतिक अभ्यास में संलग्न रहता है। 
. अपने उन्‍नत पेशेवर निर्णय, कार्य और निरंतर क्षमता के लिए जवाबदेही और जिम्मेदारी स्वीकार करता है।

F.No. -/2024-INC (IX):—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (l) of Section 6 of Indian 
Nursing Council Act, 947 (XLVHI of 947), as amended from time to time, the Indian Nursing Council hereby 
makes the following regulations, namely:— 


l. SHORT TITLE AND COMMENCEMENT 
i. These Regulations may be called the Indian Nursing Council {Nurse Practitioner in Anesthesia (NPA) - 
Postgraduate Residency Program} Regulations, 2024. 
ii. These shall come into force on the date of notification of the same in the Official Gazette of India. 


2. DEFINITIONS 
In these Regulations, unless the context otherwise requires, 


i. ‘the Act’ means the Indian Nursing Council Act, 947 (XLVII of 947) as amended from time to time; 

ii. ‘the Council’ means the Indian Nursing Council constituted under the Act; 

iii. ‘SNRC’ means the State Nurse and Midwives Registration Council, by whichever name constituted, by the 
respective State Governments; 

iv. ‘RN & RM’ means a Registered Nurse and Registered Midwife (RN & RM) and denotes a nurse who has 
completed successfully, recognised Bachelor of Nursing (B.Sc. Nursing) or Diploma in General Nursing and 
Midwifery (GNM) course, as prescribed by the Council and is registered in a SNRC as Registered Nurse and 
Registered Midwife; 

v. ‘Nurses Registration & Tracking System (NRTS)’ means a system developed by the Council and software 
developed in association with National Informatics Centre (NIC), Government of India, and hosted by NIC 
for the purpose of maintenance and operation of the Indian Nurses Register. It has standardised forms for
